name: CurrentMM.ar_moment_succ
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.arMoment decay v = v 0 + decay * CurrentMM.arMoment decay fun i => v i.succ

name: CurrentMM.ar_quadratic_succ
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay v =
    (v 0 ^ 2 + 2 * decay * v 0 * CurrentMM.arMoment decay fun i => v i.succ) +
      CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay fun i => v i.succ

name: CurrentMM.ar_reverse_factorization
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay v =
    (1 - decay ^ 2) * CurrentMM.reverseMomentEnergy n decay v + decay ^ 2 * CurrentMM.arMoment decay v ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.reverse_moment_energy_nonnegative
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ), 0 ≤ CurrentMM.reverseMomentEnergy n decay v

name: CurrentMM.ar_reverse_energy_bound
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ decay →
    CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤
      (1 + decay) ^ 2 * CurrentMM.reverseMomentEnergy n decay v - decay * (1 + decay) * CurrentMM.arMoment decay v ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.ar_quadratic_coercive
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (decay : ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ decay → decay ≤ 1 → (1 - decay) / (1 + decay) * CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤ CurrentMM.arQuadratic decay v

name: CurrentMM.decay_coercivity_monotone
type: ∀ (decay radius : ℝ), 0 ≤ decay → decay ≤ radius → (1 - radius) / (1 + radius) ≤ (1 - decay) / (1 + decay)

name: CurrentMM.mixture_execution_cost_identity

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {n : ℕ} (weights rates : ι → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost (CurrentMM.positiveMixtureKernel weights rates) v =

name: CurrentMM.probe_energy_nonnegative
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℝ), 0 ≤ CurrentMM.probeEnergy v

name: CurrentMM.mixture_execution_cost_coercive
type:

  (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ weights l) →
    (∀ (l : ι), 0 ≤ rates l ∧ rates l ≤ radius) →
      radius < 1 →

name: CurrentMM.mixture_trader_solvency_energy
type:

name: CurrentMM.counterparty_first_pulse_equity

      CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer (↑(q / 2)) (↑(rate + delta)) z

name: CurrentMM.unit_circle_split_transfer_bound
type:
∀ (z : ℂ) (q rate delta : ℝ),
  ‖z‖ = 1 →
    0 ≤ q →
      0 < rate - delta ∧ rate - delta ≤ 1 →
        0 < rate + delta ∧ rate + delta ≤ 1 → ‖CurrentMM.complexSplitTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) (↑delta) z‖ ≤ q

name: CurrentMM.positive_price_denominator_lower
type: ∀ (z G : ℂ) (a impact q : ℝ), ‖z‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ impact → ‖G‖ ≤ q → 1 - a - impact * q ≤ ‖z - ↑a - ↑impact * G‖

name: CurrentMM.positive_price_transfer_uniform_bound
type:
∀ (z G : ℂ) (a impact q : ℝ),
  ‖z‖ = 1 →
    0 ≤ a →
      0 ≤ impact →
        ‖G‖ ≤ q →
          a + impact * q < 1 → ‖CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer (↑a) (↑impact) G z‖ ≤ impact / (1 - a - impact * q)

name: CurrentMM.unit_circle_symmetric_transfer_difference_bound
type:
∀ (z : ℂ) (q rate delta eps : ℝ),
  ‖z‖ = 1 →
    0 ≤ q →
      0 < eps →
        eps ≤ rate ∧ rate ≤ 1 →
          eps ≤ rate - delta ∧ rate - delta ≤ 1 →
            eps ≤ rate + delta ∧ rate + delta ≤ 1 →
              ‖CurrentMM.complexSplitTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) (↑delta) z -
                    CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) z‖ ≤
                2 * q * delta ^ 2 / eps ^ 3

name: CurrentMM.symmetric_price_transfer_difference_uniform_bound
type:
∀ (z : ℂ) (a impact q rate delta eps : ℝ),
  ‖z‖ = 1 →
    0 ≤ a →
      0 ≤ impact →
        0 ≤ q →
          a + impact * q < 1 →
            0 < eps →
              eps ≤ rate ∧ rate ≤ 1 →
                eps ≤ rate - delta ∧ rate - delta ≤ 1 →
                  eps ≤ rate + delta ∧ rate + delta ≤ 1 →
                    ‖CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer (↑a) (↑impact)
                            (CurrentMM.complexSplitTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) (↑delta) z) z -
                          CurrentMM.complexPriceTransfer (↑a) (↑impact) (CurrentMM.complexSingleTransfer (↑q) (↑rate) z)
                            z‖ ≤
                      2 * impact ^ 2 * q / (eps ^ 3 * (1 - a - impact * q) ^ 2) * delta ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.parseval_transfer_energy_bound
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (w dH_sq U_sq : Fin N → ℝ) (M_sq E_u : ℝ),

    (∀ (k : Fin N), 0 ≤ U_sq k) →
      0 ≤ M_sq → (∀ (k : Fin N), dH_sq k ≤ M_sq) → ∑ k, w k * U_sq k ≤ E_u → ∑ k, w k * dH_sq k * U_sq k ≤ M_sq * E_u

name: CurrentMM.two_cohort_active_identification_sample_bound
type:
∀ (N_samples sigma_sq kl_req V M_delta d_eta : ℝ),

          kl_req ≤ N_samples * V ^ 2 * (M_delta * d_eta ^ 2) ^ 2 / (2 * sigma_sq) →

name: CurrentMM.counterparty_pulse_margin_all_times
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact A cost margin P B : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ a →
    0 ≤ impact →
      0 ≤ A →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
          (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →
            a + impact * ∑ i, q i ≤ 1 →
              0 ≤ margin →
                (margin + 1 / 2) * impact * A ^ 2 + (cost + margin * P) * A ≤ B →
                  ∀ (t : ℕ),
                    have mark :=
                      P + (CurrentMM.autonomousState a impact q rate (CurrentMM.pulse1 a impact q rate A) t).price;
                    margin * |(-A)| * mark ≤
                      CurrentMM.equity (B + A * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact A - cost * A) (-A) mark

name: CurrentMM.counterparty_pulse_cap_guarantees_margin
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact A cost margin P B : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),

        0 ≤ cost →
          0 < margin →
            0 < P →
              0 < B →
                (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →
                    a + impact * ∑ i, q i ≤ 1 →
                      A ≤ CurrentMM.robustQuantityCap ((margin + 1 / 2) * impact) (cost + margin * P) B →
                        ∀ (t : ℕ),
                          have mark :=
                            P +
                              (CurrentMM.autonomousState a impact q rate (CurrentMM.pulse1 a impact q rate A) t).price;
                          margin * |(-A)| * mark ≤
                            CurrentMM.equity (B + A * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact A - cost * A) (-A) mark

name: CurrentMM.arbitrarily_small_solvent_exact_disclosure
type:
∀ (B P a impact cost q rate delta margin radius : ℝ),
  0 < B →
    0 < P →
      0 ≤ a →
        0 < impact →
          0 ≤ cost →
            0 < q →
              0 < margin →
                0 < radius →
                  delta ≠ 0 →
                    a + impact * q ≤ 1 →
                      0 ≤ rate ∧ rate ≤ 1 →
                        (∀ (i : Fin 2), 0 ≤ CurrentMM.pairRates rate delta i ∧ CurrentMM.pairRates rate delta i ≤ 1) →
                          ∃ A,
                            0 < A ∧
                              A ≤ radius ∧
                                (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                    have mark :=
                                      P +
                                        (CurrentMM.autonomousState a impact (fun x => q) (fun x => rate)
                                            (CurrentMM.pulse1 a impact (fun x => q) (fun x => rate) A) t).price;
                                    margin * |(-A)| * mark ≤
                                      CurrentMM.equity (B + A * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact A - cost * A) (-A)
                                        mark) ∧
                                  (∀ (t : ℕ),
                                      have mark :=
                                        P +
                                          (CurrentMM.autonomousState a impact (fun x => q / 2)
                                              (CurrentMM.pairRates rate delta)
                                              (CurrentMM.pulse1 a impact (fun x => q / 2)
                                                (CurrentMM.pairRates rate delta) A)
                                              t).price;
                                      margin * |(-A)| * mark ≤
                                        CurrentMM.equity (B + A * CurrentMM.averageFill P impact A - cost * A) (-A)
                                          mark) ∧
                                    have e0 :=
                                      CurrentMM.counterpartyThirdEquity B P a impact cost A (fun x => q) fun x => rate;
                                    have e1 :=
                                      CurrentMM.counterpartyThirdEquity B P a impact cost A (fun x => q / 2)
                                        (CurrentMM.pairRates rate delta);
                                    CurrentMM.exactEquityDecision e0 e0 = false ∧
                                      CurrentMM.exactEquityDecision e0 e1 = true

name: CurrentMM.kernel_cost_entry_split
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (kernel : ℕ → ℝ) (trades : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n),
  trades i * trades j * kernel ((↑i).dist ↑j) =
    ((if j < i then trades i * (kernel (↑i - ↑j) * trades j) else 0) +
        if i < j then trades j * (kernel (↑j - ↑i) * trades i) else 0) +
      if i = j then kernel 0 * trades i ^ 2 else 0

name: CurrentMM.quadratic_execution_cost_triangular
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (kernel : ℕ → ℝ) (trades : Fin n → ℝ),
  CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost kernel trades =
    ∑ i, trades i * CurrentMM.baselineDisplacement kernel trades i + kernel 0 / 2 * ∑ i, trades i ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.actual_trader_fundamental_equity
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (B P impact fee : ℝ) (kernel : ℕ → ℝ) (trades : Fin n → ℝ),
  kernel 0 = impact →
    CurrentMM.equity (CurrentMM.traderCashAfter B P impact fee kernel trades) (∑ i, trades i) P =
      B - CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost kernel trades - fee * ∑ i, |trades i|

name: CurrentMM.solvent_trader_energy_bound
type:
∀ (B cost fees energy spectralFloor : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.no_free_identification_kl_to_execution_loss_bridge

∀ (loss_exec energy c_coer sigma_sq kl_req kl_obs dH_sup_sq : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_log_density_ratio_affine
type:
∀ (mean0 mean1 x : ℝ) (variance : NNReal),
  variance ≠ 0 →
    Real.log (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal mean0 variance x / ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal mean1 variance x) =
      (mean0 - mean1) / ↑variance * x + (mean1 ^ 2 - mean0 ^ 2) / (2 * ↑variance)

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_actual_llr_affine
type:
∀ (mean0 mean1 : ℝ) (variance : NNReal),
  variance ≠ 0 →
    MeasureTheory.llr (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean0 variance)
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean1 variance) =ᵐ[ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean0 variance]
      fun x => (mean0 - mean1) / ↑variance * x + (mean1 ^ 2 - mean0 ^ 2) / (2 * ↑variance)

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_actual_llr_integrable
type:
∀ (mean0 mean1 : ℝ) (variance : NNReal),

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_equal_variance_kl

name: CurrentMM.active_probing_kl_necessity_lower_bound

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_cara_exponential_integral
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (law : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (loss : Ω → ℝ) (mean : ℝ)
  (variance : NNReal) (gamma spread : ℝ),
  ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw loss (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean variance) law →
    ∫ (ω : Ω), Real.exp (-gamma * (spread - loss ω)) ∂law =
      Real.exp (-gamma * spread + mean * gamma + ↑variance * gamma ^ 2 / 2)

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_cara_certainty_equivalent
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (law : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (loss : Ω → ℝ) (mean : ℝ)
  (variance : NNReal) (gamma spread : ℝ),
  gamma ≠ 0 →
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw loss (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean variance) law →
      CurrentMM.caraCertaintyEquivalent law loss gamma spread = spread - mean - gamma * ↑variance / 2

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_cara_quote_iff
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (law : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (loss : Ω → ℝ) (mean : ℝ)
  (variance : NNReal) (gamma spread : ℝ),
  0 < gamma →
    ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw loss (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal mean variance) law →
      (0 ≤ CurrentMM.caraCertaintyEquivalent law loss gamma spread ↔ mean + gamma * ↑variance / 2 ≤ spread)

name: CurrentMM.robust_quote_iff

name: CurrentMM.robust_quote_dominates_baseline

name: CurrentMM.robust_premium_nonneg_and_pos_iff

name: CurrentMM.ema_filtered_martingale_expectation

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (alpha price oldAnchor : ℝ) (increment : Ω → ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.gaussian_actual_quantity_kl_bound

name: CurrentMM.scalar_ar1_state_variance_bound

∀ (t : ℕ) (sigma_sq s_sq E_bound : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.finite_window_abstention_lower_bound
type:
∀ (p_unstable_0 p_stable_0 p_abstain_0 p_stable_1 alpha tv tv_bound : ℝ),

    p_unstable_0 ≤ alpha →

        |p_stable_0 - p_stable_1| ≤ tv →

name: CurrentMM.is_two_world_capacity_loss
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] (p0 p1 : Ω → ℝ),
  ∑ ω, p0 ω = 1 →
    (∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ p1 ω) →
      ∀ (A : Ω → ℝ) (v0 v1 β : ℝ),
        v0 ≤ v1 →
          (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω ≤ v1) →
            CurrentMM.is_prob p0 {ω | v0 < A ω} ≤ β →

name: CurrentMM.is_two_world_attained

        have A := fun b => if b = true then v1 else v0;
        CurrentMM.is_tv p p = 0 ∧
          CurrentMM.is_prob p {ω | v0 < A ω} = β ∧
            (CurrentMM.is_expect p fun ω => v1 - A ω) = (v1 - v0) * max 0 (1 - β - CurrentMM.is_tv p p)

name: CurrentMM.is_peak_understates

name: CurrentMM.is_robust_safe_set_eq

name: CurrentMM.is_infeasible_of_cI_neg
type:
∀ (a κ L B α Φ : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_sound

name: CurrentMM.is_disclosure_monotone

name: CurrentMM.is_disclosure_strict

name: CurrentMM.is_robust_safe_antitone

name: CurrentMM.is_unsafe_between

∀ (κ0 a0 Φ δ ρ κp ap Φp δm ρm ℓ α : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_venue_example_box

name: CurrentMM.is_classify_safe_sound

∀ {Θ : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (S : ℝ → Θ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ) (Θs : Set Θ) (part : ι → Set Θ) (U : ι → ℝ) (B : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_classify_unsafe_sound

∀ {Θ : Type u_1} (S : ℝ → Θ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ) (Θs : Set Θ),

name: CurrentMM.is_robustSafeSet_closed
type:
∀ {Θ : Type u_1} (S : ℝ → Θ → ℝ) (Θs : Set Θ) (B : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_largest_safe_exists
type:
∀ {Θ : Type u_1} (S : ℝ → Θ → ℝ) (Θs : Set Θ) (B : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_coeff_moment_eq
type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (w x : Fin m → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_upper_bound
type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (w x : Fin m → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (rbar : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_lower_bound
type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (w x : Fin m → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (rbar : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_slack_shift
type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (w x : Fin m → ℝ) (c : Fin n → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (rbar s : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_cohort_row_bound
type:
∀ (η a κΦ rbar sbar : ℝ),
  1 - rbar ≤ η → a + κΦ ≤ sbar → sbar ≤ 1 → rbar ≤ 1 → 1 - η * (1 - a - κΦ) ≤ 1 - (1 - rbar) * (1 - sbar)

name: CurrentMM.is_price_row_bound
type: ∀ (a κΦ rbar sbar : ℝ), a + κΦ ≤ sbar → sbar ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ rbar → a + κΦ ≤ 1 - (1 - rbar) * (1 - sbar)

name: CurrentMM.is_step_bound
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (lam M : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.is_iter_bound
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (b : Fin n → ℝ) (lam κ : ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : Fin n), 0 ≤ J i j) →

        (∀ (j : Fin n), 0 ≤ b j) →

name: CurrentMM.is_tail_bound
type: ∀ (κ lam : ℝ) (T m : ℕ), 0 ≤ κ → 0 ≤ lam → lam < 1 → ∑ s ∈ Finset.range m, κ * lam ^ (T + s) ≤ κ * lam ^ T / (1 - lam)

name: CurrentMM.is_buffer_after_step
type:
∀ (K I p dp μ c0 U Ch Cf R : ℝ),
  0 ≤ μ →
    |dp| ≤ U →
      |I| * (1 + μ) * U + Ch + Cf + R ≤ CurrentMM.is_buffer K I p μ c0 →

name: CurrentMM.is_corrSum_ge
type: ∀ (φ : ℝ), 0 ≤ φ → ∀ (T : ℕ), ↑T ≤ CurrentMM.is_corrSum φ T

name: CurrentMM.is_o1_margin_too_small
type:
∀ (φ z σ N s1 s2 : ℝ) (T : ℕ),

        0 < N → 0 ≤ s1 → 0 ≤ s2 → s1 ^ 2 = ↑T / N → s2 ^ 2 = CurrentMM.is_corrSum φ T / N → z * σ * s1 ≤ z * σ * s2

name: CurrentMM.is_sequential_rule_correct
type:
∀ (xbar r : ℕ → ℝ) (ST S tail sB : ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), |xbar n - ST| < r n) →
    ST ≤ S ∧ S ≤ ST + tail → ∀ (n : ℕ), (xbar n + r n + tail ≤ sB → S ≤ sB) ∧ (sB < xbar n - r n → sB < S)

name: CurrentMM.is_rh_chain
type:
∀ (L0 x r fee cE s sW γ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ cE →

      cE * r - x * sW ≤ fee →
        s * max 0 (1 - γ * x ^ 2) ≤ r → L0 + x ^ 2 + max 0 (cE * s * max 0 (1 - γ * x ^ 2) - sW * x) ≤ L0 + x ^ 2 + fee

name: CurrentMM.is_iv_det_pos
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (c lam : Fin n → ℝ) (w r : ℝ),
  0 < w →
    0 ≤ r →
      r < 1 →
        (∀ (l : Fin n), 0 ≤ c l) →
          (∀ (l : Fin n), 0 ≤ lam l) →
            (∀ (l : Fin n), lam l < 1) →
              (∃ l, 0 < c l) → 0 < w * ∑ l, ∑ m, c l * c m * (1 - lam l * lam m) / (1 - r * lam m)

name: CurrentMM.is_confluent_stationary
type: ∀ (a κ φε L : ℝ), 0 < L → 0 < φε → (a * κ + φε * (1 / L - a * κ / φε)) * -L + φε = 0

name: CurrentMM.is_summed_response_closed_form
type:
∀ (a κ φ ε r η q X D F : ℝ),
  r ≠ 0 →
    η ≠ 0 →
      1 - a - q * (κ + φ * ε / r) ≠ 0 →
        X = κ + a * X + φ * D + κ * F →
          D = ε + (1 - r) * D + ε * F →
            F = (1 - η) * F + η * q * X → X = (κ + φ * ε / r) / (1 - a - q * (κ + φ * ε / r))

name: CurrentMM.is_intersection_admits_more
type:
∀ (a κ L B P1 P2 : ℝ),

        0 ≤ CurrentMM.is_cI a κ L B →
          CurrentMM.is_alphaStar a κ L B P1 ≤ CurrentMM.is_alphaStar a κ L B (min P1 P2) ∧
            CurrentMM.is_alphaStar a κ L B P2 ≤ CurrentMM.is_alphaStar a κ L B (min P1 P2)

name: CurrentMM.is_depth_eq_lt_sp
type:
∀ (θ N X b Deq Dsp : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.p2_prop_inventory_S

name: CurrentMM.defectiveJ_charpoly_det

∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {m n : ℕ} (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (B : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.exact_safe_radius_isGreatest

∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : RCLike 𝕜] {m n : ℕ} (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) 𝕜) (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) 𝕜) (B : ℝ),
  BddAbove (Set.range fun t => ‖C * J ^ t‖) →

name: CurrentMM.zero_output_no_radius_bound

name: CurrentMM.kreiss_neumann_hasSum

∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (M : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.kreiss_bilateral_radius
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),

            0 < CurrentMM.kreissConstant J ∧

                B / CurrentMM.powerBound J ≤ B / CurrentMM.kreissConstant J ∧
                  IsGreatest
                    {r |
                      0 ≤ r ∧
                        ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin n)), ‖z‖ ≤ r → ∀ (t : ℕ), ‖CurrentMM.l2Apply (1 * J ^ t) z‖ ≤ B}

name: CurrentMM.tracking_prior_variance_pos

name: CurrentMM.tracking_prior_variance_unique_positive

name: CurrentMM.tracking_gain_unit_interval
type: ∀ (Q R : ℝ), 0 < Q → 0 < R → 0 < CurrentMM.trackingGain Q R ∧ CurrentMM.trackingGain Q R < 1

name: CurrentMM.tracking_prior_riccati_equation

name: CurrentMM.tracking_gain_explicit_root

name: CurrentMM.ema_deviation_identity

name: CurrentMM.ema_next_deviation_identity

name: CurrentMM.allocation_loss_formula

name: CurrentMM.allocation_triangle_requires_efficient_baseline

name: CurrentMM.ces_price_impact_inverse_demand
type:
∀ (vHat lam p q : ℝ),

name: CurrentMM.cara_market_clearing_linear_impact
type:
∀ (m_t p_t kappa q_S q_t u_t : ℝ),

                              (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw (N * T)
                                        (CurrentMM.p1RepeatedMean N T (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a κ q' rate'))
                                        variance).real
                                    Aᶜ ≤
                                  1 / 4 →
                                ↑variance ≤
                                  2 * ↑N * ↑T * (2 * W * 2 ^ T * d ^ (2 * L + 1) * CurrentMM.p1GapConst a |κ| W H T) ^ 2

name: CurrentMM.p1_impulse_zero
type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ), CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate 0 = impact

name: CurrentMM.p1_impulse_memory_zero
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n),
  CurrentMM.cohortImpulseMemory a impact q rate i 0 = rate i * impact

name: CurrentMM.p1_impulse_price_step
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (j : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate (j + 1) =
    a * CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate j +
      impact * ∑ i, q i * CurrentMM.cohortImpulseMemory a impact q rate i j

name: CurrentMM.p1_impulse_memory_step
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (j : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.cohortImpulseMemory a impact q rate i (j + 1) =
    (1 - rate i) * CurrentMM.cohortImpulseMemory a impact q rate i j +
      rate i * CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate (j + 1)

name: CurrentMM.p1_impulse_memory_closed
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (j : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.cohortImpulseMemory a impact q rate i j =
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), rate i * (1 - rate i) ^ (j - s) * CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate s

name: CurrentMM.p1_impulse_closed_loop_recursion
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (j : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate (j + 1) =
    a * CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate j +
      impact *
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
          CurrentMM.cohortKernel q rate m * CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate (j - m)

name: CurrentMM.p1_thm_merged_model_identification
type:
∀ {n n' : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ),
  impact ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (q' rate' : Fin n' → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : ℕ), CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate j = CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q' rate' j) →
        ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
          CurrentMM.mergedWeight Finset.univ (fun i => 1 - rate i) (fun i => q i * rate i) ρ =
            CurrentMM.mergedWeight Finset.univ (fun i => 1 - rate' i) (fun i => q' i * rate' i) ρ

name: CurrentMM.p1_thm_merged_model_converse
type:
∀ {n n' : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (q' rate' : Fin n' → ℝ),
  (∀ (m : ℕ), CurrentMM.cohortKernel q rate m = CurrentMM.cohortKernel q' rate' m) →
    ∀ (j : ℕ), CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate j = CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q' rate' j

name: CurrentMM.p1_mg_kernel_expand
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (S : Finset ι) (w s : ι → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.mgKernel S w s c d m =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ↑(m.choose j) * c ^ (m - j) * d ^ j * CurrentMM.mgMoment S w s j

name: CurrentMM.p1_mg_moment_abs_le
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} (S : Finset ι) (w s : ι → ℝ) (W : ℝ) (j : ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ w i) → (∀ i ∈ S, |s i| ≤ 1) → ∑ i ∈ S, w i ≤ W → |CurrentMM.mgMoment S w s j| ≤ W

name: CurrentMM.p1_mg_binomial_tail
type:
∀ (c d : ℝ),
  0 ≤ c →
    0 ≤ d →
      ∀ (n m : ℕ),
        n ≤ m →
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico n (m + 1), ↑(m.choose j) * c ^ (m - j) * d ^ j ≤ ↑(m.choose n) * d ^ n * (c + d) ^ (m - n)

name: CurrentMM.p1_thm_kcohort_kernel_moment_gap
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (S : Finset ι) (T : Finset κ) (w s : ι → ℝ) (w' s' : κ → ℝ) (c d W : ℝ) (n m : ℕ),
  0 ≤ c →
    0 ≤ d →
      (∀ i ∈ S, 0 ≤ w i) →
        (∀ i ∈ T, 0 ≤ w' i) →
          (∀ i ∈ S, |s i| ≤ 1) →
            (∀ i ∈ T, |s' i| ≤ 1) →
              ∑ i ∈ S, w i ≤ W →
                ∑ i ∈ T, w' i ≤ W →
                  (∀ j < n, CurrentMM.mgMoment S w s j = CurrentMM.mgMoment T w' s' j) →
                    n ≤ m →
                      |CurrentMM.mgKernel S w s c d m - CurrentMM.mgKernel T w' s' c d m| ≤
                        2 * W * (↑(m.choose n) * d ^ n * (c + d) ^ (m - n))

name: CurrentMM.p1_thm_kcohort_kernel_low_orders_equal
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} (S : Finset ι) (T : Finset κ) (w s : ι → ℝ) (w' s' : κ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ) (n m : ℕ),
  (∀ j < n, CurrentMM.mgMoment S w s j = CurrentMM.mgMoment T w' s' j) →
    m < n → CurrentMM.mgKernel S w s c d m = CurrentMM.mgKernel T w' s' c d m

name: CurrentMM.p1_klFun_set_jensen
type:

                  CurrentMM.cumulativeQuantity v ≤ V →
                    funding ≤ reserve →

name: CurrentMM.actual_monetary_prefix_gate
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : _root_.Module ℝ E] (A : Module.End ℝ E) (C : E →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (H z0 : E)
  (v : ℕ → ℝ) (t N : ℕ) (reserve fee gain V : ℝ),
  t ≤ N →
    0 ≤ gain →
      0 ≤ fee →
        (∀ (j : Fin t), |C ((A ^ (t - 1 - ↑j)) H)| ≤ gain) →
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, |v j| ≤ V →
            |C (CurrentMM.carriedLinearRun A H z0 v t)| + reserve + fee * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range t, |v j| ≤
              |C ((A ^ t) z0)| + reserve + (gain + fee) * V

name: CurrentMM.hermitian_entry_power
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (j k : ι) (t : ℕ),
  (A ^ t) j k = ∑ i, ↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary j i * ↑hA.eigenvectorUnitary k i * hA.eigenvalues i ^ t

name: CurrentMM.positive_matrix_powers_dissipate
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ),
  A.PosSemidef → (1 - A).PosDef → ∀ (j k : ι), Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (A ^ t) j k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: CurrentMM.actual_zero_anchor_impulse_successor
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℕ),
  0 ≤ impact →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < rate i) →
        CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse 0 impact q rate (t + 1) =
          impact *
            ∑ i,
              ∑ j,
                CurrentMM.cohortSpectralVector 0 impact q rate i *
                    (CurrentMM.cohortSpectralMatrix 0 impact q rate ^ t) i j *
                  CurrentMM.cohortSpectralVector 0 impact q rate j

name: CurrentMM.actual_zero_anchor_impulse_dissipates
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ impact →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →
        impact * ∑ i, q i < 1 → Filter.Tendsto (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse 0 impact q rate) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: CurrentMM.actual_zero_anchor_weak_mixture
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ impact →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →
        impact * ∑ i, q i < 1 →
          ∃ lambda weights,
            (∀ (i : Option (Fin n)), 0 ≤ lambda i ∧ lambda i ≤ 1) ∧
              (∀ (i : Option (Fin n)), 0 ≤ weights i) ∧
                ∑ i, weights i = impact ∧
                  ∀ (t : ℕ), CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse 0 impact q rate t = ∑ i, weights i * lambda i ^ t

name: CurrentMM.actual_mixture_difference_formula
type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (weights lambda : ι → ℝ) (m t : ℕ),
  CurrentMM.iteratedPriceDifference (CurrentMM.positiveMixtureKernel weights lambda) m t =
    ∑ i, weights i * (1 - lambda i) ^ m * lambda i ^ t

            ∀ (m t : ℕ), 0 ≤ CurrentMM.iteratedPriceDifference (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate) m t

name: CurrentMM.actual_all_anchor_execution_coercive
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ a →
    0 < impact →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →
          a + impact * ∑ i, q i < 1 →
            ∃ radius,
              (0 ≤ radius ∧ radius < 1) ∧
                ∀ (T : ℕ) (v : Fin T → ℝ),
                  impact * ((1 - radius) / (1 + radius)) / 2 * CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤
                    CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate) v

name: CurrentMM.actual_all_anchor_execution_cost_positive

        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →

            (v ≠ fun x => 0) → 0 < CurrentMM.quadraticExecutionCost (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate) v

name: CurrentMM.actual_all_anchor_trader_energy_bound
type:
∀ {n : ℕ} (a impact : ℝ) (q rate : Fin n → ℝ),
  0 ≤ a →
    0 < impact →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 ≤ q i) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), 0 < rate i ∧ rate i ≤ 1) →
          a + impact * ∑ i, q i < 1 →
            ∃ radius,
              (0 ≤ radius ∧ radius < 1) ∧
                ∀ (T : ℕ) (v : Fin T → ℝ) (B P fee : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ fee →
                    0 ≤
                        CurrentMM.equity
                          (CurrentMM.traderCashAfter B P impact fee (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a impact q rate) v)
                          (∑ i, v i) P →
                      CurrentMM.probeEnergy v ≤ 2 * B / (impact * ((1 - radius) / (1 + radius)))
